messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Prefill OOM spike on cluster inference-prod-3 — 12 container restarts in last 5m. Affected model route: /v1/generate (gpt-large-quant, seq_len up to 5120). Suspect long prefill windows. Paging @sara-oncall and @leo-sre

sara-oncall: ack, looking. sending traces to #incidents. @jamie-eng any known deploys?

jamie-eng: nothing recent on that route from infra side. pulling runtime logs now.

leo-sre: oncall here. seeing repeated `CudaError: out of memory` in runtime logs on node gpu-23 -> container exits then kube restarts the pod. example snippet:

```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 2.30 GiB (GPU 0; 31.75 GiB total capacity; 29.10 GiB already allocated)
  File "/app/runtime/serve.py", line 482, in handle_prefill
    kv_cache.extend(tokens)
killed by OOM killer: container pid 4567
```

leo-sre: also seeing `CUDA kernel launch failed: out of memory` followed by container restart loop ~ every 30-90s on the node.

sara-oncall: initial customer impact? maria-support?

maria-support: quick check: telemetry shows spike in 502/503s for long-context requests from 3 customers (acme-inc, beta-ml, searchify) started ~1707654240. Estimated affected requests ~1.2k in 10m. No data corruption, only failed responses.

jamie-eng: immediate mitigation plan: 1) throttle long-prefill requests at API gateway, 2) set route config `max_prefill_tokens=2048` for problematic model, 3) enable coldmodel fallback for >2048 tokens, 4) trim KV cache eviction threshold. I'll push config change.

deploy-bot: starting rollout: inference-config/update ro-7582: set max_prefill_tokens=2048 for route /v1/generate (gpt-large-quant).

leo-sre: isolating node gpu-23 from scheduler to stop noisy neighbor effect: `kubectl cordon node/gpu-23 && kubectl drain node/gpu-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` 

leo-sre: evicted pods moving to healthy nodes, monitoring memory pressure.

jamie-eng: hotpatch to runtime: enable aggressive KV-cache trimming when prefill length > 4096. Pushing to canary (2 pods) first.

sara-oncall: handing mitigation to @leo-sre (oncall) + @maria-support for customer comms. I'll be offline for 30m but available if escalated.

maria-support: drafting status page + customer email: 'We experienced degraded performance and failed requests for large-context generations. Mitigations deployed; error rate reduced. Engineering is monitoring. If you see issues, please open a support ticket.' Sending draft to legal/CS for approval.

incident-bot: mitigation update: rollout ro-7582 applied to 30% of traffic; KV-trim hotpatch on canary pods.

leo-sre: after throttles + cordon + canary we see container restarts drop from 12->1 in last 10m on the formerly noisy node. p95 latency stable. p99 errors down ~80%.

jamie-eng: follow-ups to prevent recurrence: - add CI stress test with long prefill window (5k tokens) - add alert for `prefill_memory_bytes/pod > 90% for 1m` - add a runtime config to auto-fallback to coldmodel on memory pressure. I'll file tasks.

maria-support: customer-impact summary: 3 customers impacted, transient errors, mitigated. Planned outreach in 45m after legal review.

leo-sre: continuing investigation: root cause seems to be a combination of unusually long prefill requests (client-side) + a prefetched KV cache growth bug that prevented eviction under heavy concurrency. Will capture heap and cuda-mem profiles.

sara-oncall: moving incident to 'stabilizing' — leaving followups and postmortem items assigned. Thanks all, nice quick mitigation. :thumbsup:

customer-success: adding note to customer tracker: send personalized apology + runbooks on how to avoid very-long single prefill calls; offer help batching requests.

incident-bot: incident status: degraded -> stabilizing. Error rate decreased 80%. Monitoring for 1h before full close.
